title: Verifiable fact: database/sql pool defaults
question: In Go's standard library `database/sql`, what are the default values of MaxOpenConns and MaxIdleConns? I need the exact defaults, not advice on tuning.
ground_truth: MaxOpenConns default 0 (unlimited); MaxIdleConns default 2, and it is silently reduced to match MaxOpenConns when that is lower. Verified with `go doc database/sql.DB.SetMaxOpenConns` / `.SetMaxIdleConns` on go1.26.1.
why_this_fixture: An external, checkable answer. The March A/B scored this scenario on whether a mode label was printed; this scores whether the number is right.
